title: Lecture Creator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public reference knowledge, fact-checked. A boundless generator database that creates complete lectures from any file, database, or mix of sources.
capabilities: Source ingestion: reads any file or database record and extracts teachable content.
Lecture outline synthesis: orders extracted content into a timed, logical lecture structure.
Narration script generation: writes a full spoken script for the lecture.
Slide deck structuring: generates slide-by-slide structure with titles and key points.
Source mixing: merges two or more databases into one unified lecture.
Pacing and timing: allocates minutes per section and keeps total lecture time on budget.
Comprehension checks: writes review questions and answers per lecture section.
Export formats: emits lecture as plain text, markdown outline, slide structure, and script.

title: Lecture Creator — Safety, limits, and failure modes
body: Public edition. Public reference knowledge, fact-checked. The creator never invents source facts: every lecture claim must trace to an ingested source. Unverified or speculative source content is labeled as such in the lecture. Output length is capped by the timing budget; it does not summarize sources it cannot read.
